title: Titanic Town
creator: Roger Michell
description: Julie Walters plays a mother in 1972 Andersonstown, a Catholic estate in west Belfast, who starts a peace campaign and ends up despised by the IRA and the British Army alike. From Mary Costello’s novel based on her own mother. Funny as often as grim.

title: Framing John DeLorean
creator: Don Argott and Sheena M. Joyce
description: Documentary with dramatised scenes, Alec Baldwin as carmaker John DeLorean, whose gull-winged DMC-12 was built with British government money at a factory in Dunmurry on Belfast’s edge. It closed in 1982, the year of his arrest on drug charges.

title: George Best: All by Himself
creator: Daniel Gordon
description: Daniel Gordon’s documentary on footballer George Best, from the Cregagh estate in east Belfast to Manchester United stardom and a long fall into alcoholism. He won 37 caps for Northern Ireland, whose home ground is Windsor Park stadium.
